title: Wild 110 Crans-Montana — Wildstrubel by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Wildstrubel by UTMB
claims: Wild 110 is 113 km with 6,600 m of gain, starts at Crans-Montana on Friday 10 September 2027 at 23:00 and has a 30-hour limit.

The course table gives cumulative distances to Varneralp 12.9, Leukerbad 22.8, Gemmipass 27.5, Kandersteg 43.6, Ueschine 49.4, Adelboden 60.0, Sillerebüel 69.3, Lenk 78.0, Iffigenalp 86.4, Cabane Wildstrubel 92.1, Tseuzier 102.7 and Crans-Montana 113.7 km, while the page header gives 113 km.

The page publishes cut-offs at Leukerbad Sat 04:15, Kandersteg Sat 09:00, Adelboden Sat 14:15, Lenk Sat 19:30, Iffigenalp Sat 22:00 and Tseuzier Sun 04:00, and gives no separate finish cut-off beyond the 30-hour limit.
The race header shows 8 Running Stones while the explanatory text at the bottom of the same page says 4 Running Stones.
The page labels Finals Access as '100m-direct-entry-major' and describes the route over the Gemmi (2,268 m) and Rawyl (2,427 m) passes, with Cabane Wildstrubel at 2,800 m as the highest point.
